nodes.action: Extract externally observable success criteria, protected invariants, failure conditions, and permitted edit scope.
nodes.name: Define contract and scope
preconditions: A failing software task and its existing project are available
nodes.validator: All required behaviors and non-goals are stated without prescribing implementation details.

nodes.action: Trace the affected execution path and compare implementation assumptions with direct failure evidence.
nodes.name: Inspect implementation and evidence
nodes.validator: Each candidate is linked to concrete code and evidence.

nodes.action: Reproduce the failure and probe nearby boundary conditions while recording status, payload, logging, and side effects.
inputs: Malformed, concurrent, delayed, or adversarial variants as applicable
nodes.name: Exercise the failure mode
preconditions: A runnable test or execution path exists
nodes.validator: The observed failure distinguishes the real defect from unrelated symptoms.

nodes.action: Choose the smallest causal change that restores the violated invariant while preserving normal behavior, interface shape, and appropriate failure visibility.
nodes.name: Select root cause and repair invariant
nodes.validator: The repair design explains the failure and does not rely on hiding errors or removing required behavior.

nodes.action: Modify the existing implementation in place, retaining compatible interfaces and adding only narrowly scoped state, validation, error, or synchronization handling required by the invariant.
nodes.name: Apply focused implementation change
preconditions: A validated repair design is available
nodes.validator: The patch is localized, syntactically valid, and preserves the declared public contract.

nodes.action: Check that repaired paths retain required rejection, status, diagnostic, and control-flow signaling, and correct any accidental swallowing or fallthrough introduced by the change.
nodes.name: Preserve required failure signaling
preconditions: The repair design identifies required failure visibility
nodes.validator: Required failures remain observable with appropriate status and diagnostics, without adding task-specific answer content.

nodes.action: Run focused tests and adversarial checks, confirm observable outputs and diagnostics, and verify that the fix generalizes across equivalent inputs and related execution paths.
inputs: Concurrency or timing probes when relevant
nodes.name: Verify transfer and regressions
nodes.validator: Normal behavior passes, the original failure is corrected, required failures remain visible, and no prohibited workaround is used.
